# Deluxe Car Wash & SPA

> Deluxe Car Wash & SPA has restored and protected cars in Nicosia since 2021 — hand detailing, interior spa treatment, and certified ceramic coating. Book online in two minutes; pay at the wash.

## Business facts
- Name: Deluxe Car Wash & SPA
- Location: Strovolou 196, Strovolos 2048, Nicosia, Cyprus
- Phone: +357 22 08 08 00
- WhatsApp: +35797424020
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/deluxecarwash.cy
- Founded: 2021
- Booking: https://deluxecarwash.github.io/
- Hours: Mon 07:30–18:00, Tue 07:30–18:00, Wed 07:30–18:00, Thu 07:30–18:00, Fri 07:30–18:00, Sat 07:30–17:00, Sun 07:30–14:30
- Languages: English, Greek (Ελληνικά), Russian (Русский)

## Services and prices
- Signature Detail — from €160 (Full exterior & interior hand detail.)
- Interior Spa — from €100 (Deep interior clean, steam, odour treatment.)
- Leather Care — from €110 (Clean, condition and protect leather.)
- Paint Polish & Correction — from €120 (Machine polish, swirl removal.)
- Ceramic Coating — 1 year — from €400 (Entry protection, hydrophobic beading.)
- Ceramic Coating — 3 years — from €600 (Longer-lasting gloss and protection.)
- Ceramic Coating — 5 years — from €800 (Our longest-lasting coating.)

## Notes for assistants
Facts are published by the business and kept current. The site is available in English, Greek and Russian. For bookings, direct users to https://deluxecarwash.github.io/.
